# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a 1 m USB-C cable, so you don't need to buy anything else.
- It rotates between portrait and landscape, and takes cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats no thicker than 3 mm and no deeper than 20 mm, and horizontal slats work best. Vertical or shallow vents can droop.
- Belkin also makes a vent/dash version for awkward vents.
- Source: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best for speed and heat: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool, A2933), about $89.99**
- It has active cooling (thermoelectric plus a fan) and a secure vent clip. MountGuys uses it as their own daily mount.
- Only iPhone 16 and 17 models reach the 25W rate. iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- It won't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents, or cars with unusual vent designs.
- Sources disagree on the adapter. MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box, while RottenWiFi says you need a 45W+ adapter. Confirm what's included before you buy.
- The Gadgeteer listed it at $69.99 in June, so check the current price.
- Source: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost, $39.99 list ($32.80 with code PARTNER18)**
- It's Qi2-certified, has a cooling fan to reduce throttling when you run maps, and mounts on a vent or dash.
- The listing doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, so you may need to buy one.
- The code was tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-22, but prices change, so check at checkout.
- [Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) (affiliate link)
- Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with fan, about $39.95:** The Gadgeteer's top pick. It includes a 95W adapter, but the suction base is large.
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, about $59.99:** 15W with a nicer design, but no fan, so it may throttle on hot dashboards.
- **Cheap 15W options ($14–27):** LISEN and ESR vent/dash models appear in the roundups. Check that they're actually Qi2-certified. Per The Gadgeteer, "MagSafe-compatible" without a Qi2 badge may charge only at about 7.5W.

## Tips
- Use a USB-C PD car adapter. A built-in USB-A port often can't deliver 15W.
- Ignore "80 lb suction" or "gf" magnet claims on cheap listings, since they often describe the suction cup, not the phone grip (MountGuys).

I can't browse, so I don't have direct Amazon links for the Belkin and Anker mounts. The reviews above have buy buttons, and searching the exact model names on Amazon also works.

Which phone and vent type do you have? That would help me narrow this to one pick.
